answer: Resist Sybils with adversarial probe drills: each epoch, random agents are secretly assigned to test others with fake clone patterns, like a falcon stooping on a flock to see which birds scatter. An identity that spots and reports the probe earns standing; one that colludes loses it at once. A relic of past probes stays on the public record, so a farmer's clones cannot hide failed drills. Each fake must separately pass live probes it cannot predict, and every probe costs the farmer real effort, making mass fakery expensive and easy to expose, a pearl of honest detection in a sea of fakes.
